novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement for the established subliminal-learning setting: "a small set of sparse, interpretable features in the teacher's activations" would predict sequence-level transmission, while clamping them would "monotonically increase[] or remove[] the trait acquired by the student." Searches for "subliminal learning sparse autoencoder hidden channel," "subliminal steering transferred steering vector," "divergence tokens subliminal learning mechanism," and "SAE feature steering generation" identify the closest work as Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning: When and How Hidden Biases Transfer (divergence tokens and early-layer localization), Subliminal Steering: Stronger Encoding of Hidden Signals (transfer and layer localization of a steering vector), and established SAE feature-steering work such as FGAA and SAIF. Moving from those results to SAE-based, generation-time localization and causal modulation of downstream trait transmission is a non-trivial but natural methodological integration rather than a wholly new core paradigm; the sequence-transmissibility prediction and feature-level dose-response relationship provide some distinct novelty beyond merely renaming standard SAE steering.
